d:
Join us as we fly 16 hrs to Hong Kong for an epic stopover on our way to China!! We are so happy to go back here after almost 10 years since our last trip
has a special treat for anyone who wants to recreate our stay at the Ritz-Carlton!
When you book your stay through their Hong Kong Experience package, you can unlock some sweet perks:
Deluxe Room → Free upgrade to Deluxe Seaview Room
Deluxe Victoria Harbour Room → Includes breakfast for two
Grand Seaview Room → Includes breakfast for two + a bottle of champagne
Offer valid until March 31st.
